nom: CNP Laboratory Propolis Deepcerin Cleansing Balm

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report that the balm leaves their face soft and moisturized rather than tight, with one calling it a new winter staple for naturally dry skin.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers report the balm is gentle and non-irritating, including around the eyes, though one non-sensitive reviewer warns the scent could be overpowering for sensitive skin.
segments.combination: One reviewer notes the balm is not too oily and leaves skin soft and silky without heaviness, suiting combination-leaning skin.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say their skin feels hydrated, soft, and not tight or stripped after rinsing; one reviewer explicitly contrasts it with cleansers that usually leave her dry.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers state the product does not strip or irritate skin and one with sensitive skin reports no discomfort or sensitivity around the eyes.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report the balm did not cause new breakouts and is non-comedogenic, but two reviewers say it made them break out, one calling it not gentle for her skin.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer notes it did not add pimples and is gentle, while another separately reports breaking out a bit after use.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes the balm feels moisturizing without being oily, and another contrasts it favorably with cleansing balms that usually feel oily afterward.

extraits.texte: Not a fan of the product. The container is cool and I like how the cleaner is dispensed, but I don't like the product. The scent is SO strong and smells of a lemon cleaning product. I could smell it on my face after cleansing again with a different cleanser. It did not take my makeup off at all. There are a lot better products I'd try before this one.

I received this product for free in exchange for a review! Overall, I like this balm pretty alright! I love that the package is twist up, so you don't waste any product and it keeps everything sanitary. The balm is light and feels good on my skin, and once rinsed off, my face is extremely soft. It has a nice smell to it, too, almost citrusy but fresh at the same time. It was also helpful in removing stubborn makeup remnants! My only issue is that this product unfortunately made me breakout a bit. Otherwise, this balm was great!

I recently tried Propolis Cleansing Balm and they made a new costumer out of me! The packaging is sleek and well-designed, which makes it feel a bit more luxurious right from the start. The applicator is amazing—super easy to use and definitely a huge plus for me because it keeps things mess-free and convenient. The balm itself smells fantastic, not overpowering but just enough to make the experience enjoyable. I didn't need to use a large amount to cover my face, which makes the product feel like it will last a while. I attached a picture of how much product I actually applied. After rinsing, my skin didn't feel dry at all; in fact, it felt soft and moisturized, which is a huge plus since so many cleansers can leave my skin tight. It removed my makeup easily and I didn't have to reapply to get it all off! Overall, this cleansing balm is effective, pleasant to use, and gentle on the skin—I'd definitely recommend it.

extraits.titre: Non comedogenic and sanitary! I love it.
extraits.texte: When I received this product to try out, I was excited because I love Korean skincare. However, this was far better than I even thought it was going to be. The packaging was easy and sanitary with a scraper that dispenses product (love). Most cleansing balms break me out but this one was very gentle on my skin and did not clog my pores at all while removing my makeup pretty well. If you're thinking about purchasing this product, it is a good one!

extraits.titre: Gentle, Effective and Perfect for Everyday Cleansing ✨
extraits.texte: I really like this cleansing balm 🫶🏼The texture is thick at first,but it melts into an oil as soon as it touches the skin.It removes makeup and SPF really well,even waterproof mascara comes off without rubbing.After rinsing,my skin feels soft and clean,not tight or greasy.The only small downside is that it has a light herbal scent that might not be for everyone,but it fades quickly and doesn't irritate my skin.

I use this cleanser to take off my makeup after a long day. I find that this product was able to take off my makeup and not strip my skin. After each use I was felt with my face feeling moisturized and cleanse. I love this product on my dry skin.

Its a very effective cleaning balm. It easily removes my makeup without adding any pimples to my skin. Its gentle around the eye area and doesn't smell too strong. I highly recommend it for those with sensitive skin
